title: Checkout v2 launch readiness
summary_markdown:

transcript.text: The 3DS2 migration. We're still on 3DS1 for cards. I'll take that, and I'll pick up the error-rate dashboard too.
I'll write the comms plan for Support and Sales by the 14th, so they have two weeks.
